verdict_scope: Statement about the MANIPULATION METRIC's scale, not about the controllers and not about whether RULESET_V2 contains a trade-off.
what_happened: ONE_DEFENDER sits near the ceiling of the binary home-presence measure while BOTH_ATTACK still spends substantial time near home during flag returns, tags and resets. Observed separation +0.2257 (CI95 [+0.1906,+0.2588]) is reliable but below the 0.25 floor. The ruler is compressed, not the treatment: tightening the hold radius could not reliably create a 0.25 contrast on a nearly-full checkbox.

strategic_contrasts.reason: manipulation gates interpretation; these did not count

controllers_unchanged: BLUE_BOTH_ATTACK_V2 / BLUE_ONE_DEFENDER_V2 were NOT modified. The earlier blanket instruction to build V2B assumed a genuine separation failure; the full run showed reliable separation with a poorly scaled binary metric.
successor: Gate 2D -- same frozen controllers, same scenario, same capture-ledger latency outcomes; manipulation moves to mean_num_home_defenders in AGENT units, symmetric with mean_num_attackers. Fresh seed block required.
